purpose: Read-only snapshot of the real PHR publisher for isolated offline regression; never used by the production publisher.

history/README.md.content:
# History

This directory will contain chronological PMOS Publication Bundles.

Stage 2 established the first real PMOS Publication Bundle v1.

Stage 3 adds automatic publication of completed PMOS tasks into this chronological archive.

Stage 3.5 performs a one-time historical bootstrap on an isolated branch using the same bundle contract.

Future direction:

`YYYY/MM/DD/<publication-bundle>/`

Directories must not be classified by business or technical topic.
